caption: Butternut Squash Mac & Cheese 🎃🧀 Creamy mac & cheese with an entire butternut squash blended into the sauce 🤍 Ingredients: 1 medium butternut squash 8 oz small pasta 1½ cups whole milk 2 tbsp butter 2 cups cheddar ½ cup Parmesan 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder ¼ tsp paprika Black pepper Salt (1 year+ only) Roast the squash cut-side down at 400°F for 40–50 min until completely soft. Blend the flesh with milk, butter & seasonings. Warm over low heat and stir in the cheeses until creamy. Cook the pasta, then toss with 2–2½ cups sauce, adding a splash of pasta water if needed.
